feature_name: Gemini Code Assist OpenAPI spec generation
summary: Gemini Code Assist API management can generate OpenAPI specifications from natural language prompts using enterprise context and a visual API designer.

supporting_pages.title: "Creating an API proxy from an OpenAPI Specification \_|\_ Apigee \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: For example: http://mocktarget.apigee.net servers property from the OpenAPI Specification The following provides an excerpt from the OpenAPI Specification showing the properties that are used to pre-populate the fields. openapi: 3.0.0 info: description : OpenAPI Specification for the Apigee mock target service endpoint. version: 1.0.0 title : Mock Target API paths: /: get: summary: View personalized greeting operationId: View a personalized greeting description: View a personalized greeting for the specified or guest user. parameters: - name: user in: query description: Your user name. required: false schema: type: string responses: "200": description: Success ... servers : - url: http://mocktarget.apigee.net - url: https://mocktarget.apigee.net ...
